semver_policy.patch: bug fixes and compatible hardening; no intentional protected API removals
semver_policy.minor: backward-compatible additions; no intentional protected API removals
semver_policy.major: may contain intentional breaking changes when documented with migration guidance
semver_policy.prerelease: preview behavior may evolve before stable release

deprecation_policy.published_stable_api: prefer deprecation before removal where security or correctness does not require immediate change

claim_boundary: This contract governs project release discipline. It is not a warranty, SLA, external certification, or statement that preview APIs are frozen.
